Quick overview · follow 01 → 10 · two separate APIs, one explicit save

g.text: Bills never writes to the database. The scan ends when three form fields are filled in.
Persistence is the ordinary Add Expense path, reached only if the user submits.
Leaving the form after a scan

svg.text: Stages 01–06 are the Bills module. Stages 08–10 are the pre-existing Add Expense path, reused unchanged and cross-referenced rather than duplicated.
